# nico_site (Data Source)

Site is a datacenter that contains physical hardware and networking resources. All resources created by Provider or Tenant are directly or indirectly anchored to the Site object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_site" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "site_name" {
  value = data.nico_site.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `include_machine_stats` (String) Include a breakdown of Machine counts by lifecycle status and health. Requires Provider Admin role.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) Filter Sites by Infrastructure Provider ID
- `is_flow_enabled` (String) Filter Sites by NICo Flow enabled flag. Requires Provider Admin role.
- `is_native_networking_enabled` (String) Filter Sites by native networking enabled flag. Requires Provider Admin role.
- `is_network_security_group_enabled` (String) Filter Sites by network security group enabled flag. Requires Provider Admin role.
- `is_nv_link_partition_enabled` (String) Filter Sites by NVLink partitioning enabled flag. Requires Provider Admin role.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all Sites. Input will be matched against name, description, location, contact, and status fields
- `status` (String) Filter Sites by Status. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one status
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter Sites by Tenant ID

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Attributes) Site capabilities used for feature availability and configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `contact` (Attributes) Site contact information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact))
- `created` (String) Date/time when the Site was created
- `description` (String) Optional description for the Site
- `is_online` (Boolean) Indicates if the Site is currently reachable from Cloud
- `is_serial_console_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if Serial Console is enabled for the Site by the Provider
- `is_serial_console_ssh_keys_enabled` (Boolean) Only visible to Tenant retrieving the Site. Indicates if Serial Console access using SSH Keys is enabled by Tenant
- `location` (Attributes) Site location information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `machine_stats` (Attributes) Machine counts by status for the Site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_stats))
- `name` (String) Name of the Site
- `org` (String) NGC organization ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Site
- `registration_token` (String) Token that can be used to register a Site. Value only exposed to Provider
- `registration_token_expiration` (String) Date/time when registration token expires. Value only exposed to Provider
- `serial_console_hostname` (String) Serial console hostname of the site controller
- `serial_console_idle_timeout` (Number) Maximum idle time in seconds before Serial Console is disconnected
- `serial_console_max_session_length` (Number) Maximum length of Serial Console session in seconds
- `site_agent_version` (String) Version of the Site Agent software
- `site_controller_version` (String) Version of the Site Controller software
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Site was last updated
